ops.title: Bounded live prototype: hermes-on-Apple-container feasibility (USER-GATED: installs the container daemon on the host)
ops.description: Run the 5-experiment prototype matrix from the spike memo (note: "hermes → Apple container spike: NO-GO for production now"): (1) filtered socktainer chain behind hermes-docker-proxy, (2) NixOS `container machine` wholesale image, (3) pf child-anchor egress enforcement vs container-network-vmnet incl. reboot, (4) recovery matrix (cold boot + per-component kills), (5) 24-72h memory/state soak + restic drill. Prereq: user approval to install apple/container (>=1.1.0) on the host — the spike explicitly excluded this. Production gates are conjunctive: all five must pass. Do NOT start on upstream triggers alone; see the memo's re-check list (#158, #286, #66 reversal, egress primitive, ballooning).

ops.text: All five prototype experiments executed with recorded results
Go/no-go production decision recorded in cc-notes superseding the 2026-07-14 memo
